computer status: show the computer's name, state, image and screen

Usage: computer [-c NAME] status [--json]

Shows which computer the command talks to and its state, image and screen
size.

Options:
  --json               print JSON instead of text

Prints: "key: value" lines; with --json an object

Examples:
  computer -c alice status

Where: inside a computer it acts locally; elsewhere on the chosen remote (-c NAME)
Exit codes: 0 ok, 1 error, 2 usage error
